The largest bone in the human body is the femur (thigh bone).

Regarding the effectiveness of the described physical therapy techniques:

Myofascial release therapy is generally considered effective for treating myofascial pain syndrome. By applying gentle, sustained pressure to the fascial connective tissues, this technique aims to release restrictions that limit motion and cause pain. Clinical evidence and patient reports often suggest that it can successfully relieve pain and increase the range of motion by targeting sensitive trigger points in the muscles. However, its effectiveness can vary depending on the individual, the severity of the condition, and how it is integrated into a broader treatment plan.
